metadata.name: OceanScope 3D curated sample dataset
metadata.generated_from: Deterministic seeded mock-ocean engine (identical to frontend fallback)

data_sources.name: Numerical Ocean Model
data_sources.platform_description: Regional ocean circulation model, INCOIS configuration
data_sources.quality_control: Model QC v3.2 — automated sanity checks
data_sources.description: Gridded forecasts of ocean state produced by solving the primitive equations on a numerical grid. In this prototype the model fields are simulated with a smooth analytical field plus realistic bias and noise.

data_sources.name: Argo Float Network
data_sources.spatial_coverage: Bay of Bengal & Arabian Sea, 0 – 2000 m
data_sources.description: Battery-powered robotic floats that drift with deep currents and surface every 10 days to transmit a temperature–salinity profile. India's Argo fleet is deployed under the Ministry of Earth Sciences.

data_sources.name: Moored Buoy Network
data_sources.spatial_coverage: Coastal & open-ocean stations along the Indian rim
data_sources.description: Anchored instrument platforms measuring surface meteorology and upper-ocean conditions every hour. The Ocean Moored Buoy Network is operated by NIOT, Chennai for tsunami, cyclone and monsoon support.

data_sources.name: Ship-based Measurements
data_sources.platform_description: Research & survey vessel CTD / XBT casts
data_sources.spatial_coverage: Cruise tracks across the Arabian Sea and Bay of Bengal
data_sources.description: High-accuracy conductivity-temperature-depth (CTD) profiles collected on ocean research vessels, plus expendable bathythermograph (XBT) lines and hull-mounted current profilers.
